intentions.title: Render every PortableDoc block type to width-aware ANSI terminal output, achieving parity with the Phoenix HTML renderer (api/lib/barkpark/portable_doc/render.ex)
intentions.evidence: pdrender.go's package doc calls itself the terminal counterpart to render.ex, walking the same {version, blocks[]} document to styled lines via lipgloss instead of HTML; blocks.go, richblocks.go, fields.go, v2fields.go, gridblocks.go, taskblocks.go, hardblocks.go each cover a distinct block family (heading/paragraph/list, table/figure/action/pullquote, field-*, composite/arrayOf/codelist/localizedText, task-list/board/roadmap/detail, diagram/asciicast/image).

intentions.title: Keep pdrender extractable as a standalone module independent of Barkpark's TUI/apiclient
intentions.evidence: pdrender.go doc comment: 'IMPORT DISCIPLINE: this package imports ONLY lipgloss + x/ansi + the stdlib. It MUST NOT import barkpark's main/TUI model or internal/apiclient'; Theme and Block types are pdrender-owned so callers inject/decode rather than pdrender depending on them; taskblocks.go and mermaid.go repeat the same import-discipline note, tied to render_test.go's go-list-deps check.

intentions.title: Degrade honestly rather than fake unsupported terminal capabilities (diagrams, casts, images, graphics protocols)
intentions.evidence: hardblocks.go: diagram/asciicast/image render as clearly-labeled bordered placeholder boxes stating their ceiling ('never a fake of a capability it lacks'), mirroring render.ex's email-mode degradation; MinWidth=20 graceful-degradation floor drops box chrome and renders flat below threshold; taskblocks.go degrades to a dim placeholder line when resolved data is absent rather than fetching or guessing.

intentions.title: Draw the 80%-common subset of Mermaid diagrams natively in the terminal without external dependencies
intentions.evidence: mermaid.go implements a dependency-free parser for flowchart/graph and sequenceDiagram syntax (stdlib+regexp only); mermaidflow.go/mermaidflowlr.go/mermaidseq.go/mermaidheur.go turn the parsed model into rectangular box-drawing layouts with connector buses; unparseable input degrades to the honest folded-source box in hardblocks.go.

intentions.title: Drive terminal color/typography from a single generated design-token source shared with other surfaces
intentions.evidence: tokens_gen.go header: 'Code generated by design/emit.mjs from design/tokens.json. DO NOT EDIT'; defines GenTone*/GenPrimary/GenChrome*/code tones as lipgloss.AdaptiveColor pairs consumed by theme.go's buildTheme — part of the unified-aesthetic one-token-manifest initiative reaching CLI chrome.

intentions.title: Support light and dark terminal themes with a stable identity/mode split so multiple skins never collide
intentions.evidence: theme.go: Theme carries both `name` (light/dark mode) and `themeID` (skin identity, e.g. 'evergreen') that together key code.go's chroma-style memo cache; isZero() detects an uninjected Theme and falls back to the registry default.

intentions.title: Render live task/roadmap widgets (task-list, task-board, task-detail, roadmap) in the terminal on pre-resolved data, matching the web reader's task widgets
intentions.evidence: taskblocks.go: 'the terminal counterparts of the PortableDoc task widgets the web/Studio reader draws'; documents a RESOLVED-DATA CONTRACT (paper resolver replaces `query` with literal snapshot/task data; pdrender never fetches) and a shared status vocabulary in gridblocks.go (roleForStatus/glyphForRole/glyphForStatus).

intentions.title: Render spreadsheet/table data (PdSheet and embedded sheet snapshots) as aligned terminal grids with documented fidelity losses
intentions.evidence: sheet.go: sheetRenderer supports optional head row (uppercase+muted-bold) and per-column col_widths pre-padding for lipgloss/table auto-sizing; a second adapter lifts embedded sheet-document snapshot.head/rows onto the same PdSheet path, explicitly documenting that merged ranges collapse to their anchor-cell value.
